description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Awoken Holy], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast] and [Graceful Influence Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Awoken Holy
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Graceful Influence Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Graceful Influence after using two Holy abilities
